why.title: Onboarding is usually somebody's second job.
paragraphs: In a small business or organization, screening applicants, collecting paperwork and getting people set up tends to fall to whoever has a spare hour. Some weeks that works. Other weeks applications sit, forms go missing, and a good person loses interest while they wait to hear back.
It also means each new person gets a different start depending on who happened to handle them. Working with a partner that follows one structured process gives everyone the same start.
